head: What's actually at stake
r: A date, maybe a whole relationship

items.head: Downside: tiny
items.sub: She says no. You feel weird for an afternoon.

items.head: Upside: huge
items.sub: She says yes. It could change your whole year.

label: WHAT MOST GUYS DO
head: Wait for the perfect moment
sub: It never comes. Then someone else asks her.

label: THE BONUS
head: Every no makes the next ask easier
sub: Ask 10 times and rejection stops stinging.

text: Not asking is the only option with *zero upside.*
